subtitle: 칼림도어에서 배 타고 온다는 적반하장 흑마

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
스트라솔름 입구 전원 대기!
마지막 흑마님만 오시면 출발!
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle three-quarter view of cute 2.5-head chibi SD characters standing before a small stone dungeon archway with eerie green mist on a minimal stone patch, pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, the Orc Warrior holds a one-handed axe and sturdy shield while waving cheerfully. On the right, the Skyborne Mage has her staff stowed on her back and holds a small rolled parchment checklist, looking around expectantly.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
저 반대편 대륙인데요.
배랑 그리핀 타면 30분 컷!
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-three-quarter medium shot on a tiny wooden dock plank with minimal sunny sand and water lines, pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, the cute 2.5-head chibi SD Human Warlock sits relaxed on a wooden crate with her spellbook stowed, holding a folded travel map and waving casually. Tucked close beside her shoulder, her cute round floating purple chibi Voidwalker pet holds a small travel pouch.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
적어도 귀환석 맞춰놓고
파티 구하는 게 상식 아님?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic slight low-angle shot back at the dungeon entrance on a minimal stone patch, pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, the cute 2.5-head chibi SD Orc Warrior has her axe and shield stowed on her back and holds up a smooth oval blue-swirling glowing Hearthstone in one hand while yelling furiously with comical anger veins. On the right, the Skyborne Mage with staff stowed sweatdrops awkwardly.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
파장이 제 위치 미리 보고
초대했어야 하는 거 아닌가요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Front-facing medium close-up on a pure #FFFFFF background. On the right, the cute 2.5-head chibi SD Human Warlock with her spellbook stowed tilts her head calmly with an innocent, shameless deadpan smile and one index finger raised. On the left beside her, her cute floating purple chibi Voidwalker pet blinks blankly with tiny sweatdrops.

Extreme giant bust-up close-up filling 80 percent of the frame height on a pure #FFFFFF background. The cute 2.5-head chibi SD Orc Warrior on the left and Skyborne Mage on the right are frozen in exaggerated comical culture-shock horror, jaws dropped wide open, blank white circles for eyes, and pale vertical shock lines radiating from their faces.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
뉴비도 이 정도 상식은 안다!
그냥 칼추방하고 새로 구해!
cuts.visual_prompt: Three-quarter over-the-shoulder view from behind the left side on a minimal stone ground line, pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, the cute 2.5-head chibi SD Orc Warrior with weapons stowed firmly crosses out a name on a small glowing party-roster parchment. On the right, the Skyborne Mage with staff stowed leans forward with fierce narrowed starry eyes and puffed cheeks, pointing decisively at the parchment.
